blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House committee on appropriations on Wednesday approved two measures in two separate hearings. The first one seeks to establish safety standards for the protection of children in social media and online gambling platforms. The second one aims to reorganize the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG). The bills were introduced by House Speaker Faustino “Bojie” Dy III, Majority Floor Leader Sandro Marcos and other lawmakers. READ: House panel approves social media ban for kids The bill on children’s protection intends to put in place restrictions on social media access of children below 13 years of age.
